verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a cloud browser-automation platform like Steel, so the axis applies. The evidence covers on-demand sessions, the CLI, agent framework integrations and traces, but nothing documents a built-in scheduler, cron triggers or recurring workflows. On-demand session creation is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
